name: dashnet (dash-network-go)
author: ktechmidas
description: The Go engine behind the Dash status console: it creates, upgrades, resets and destroys Dash test networks and devnets (Core, Tenderdash and Platform on managed hosts). Useful if you need to understand or extend how network operations are planned and run; operations themselves are started through the status console, not by running this directly.
access: The repository is public. Running operations goes through the status console; ask in #infra-claw.
